sources.citation: American Statistical Association. American Statistical Association Releases Statement on Statistical Significance and P-Values. March 7, 2016.
sources.review_definition: Complete review requires substantive examination of the entire original source including all figures, tables, appendices and referenced supplements; hashing/retrieval alone is insufficient.
sources.examined: All text returned by the web PDF reader, including the six principles.
sources.unexamined: Page images/layout and linked journal statement/associated commentaries were not fully examined.
sources.findings: Conclusions require context and more than a p-value threshold; a p-value does not measure the probability that a hypothesis is true.
sources.limitations: Targeted methodological rationale only; no claim to have reviewed associated bibliographies or implemented/validated a general inference engine.

sources.citation: Yen, J.; Leber, D.; Pibida, L. Comparing Instruments. NIST Technical Note 2106. September 2020. DOI 10.6028/NIST.TN.2106.
sources.review_definition: Complete review requires substantive examination of the entire original source including all figures, tables, appendices and referenced supplements; hashing/retrieval alone is insufficient.
sources.examined: Targeted section 5 passages on null hypotheses/indifference zone and 5.4 confidence-interval representation, plus title/contents.
sources.unexamined: Remaining sections, derivations, figures including Figure 7, examples, sample-size calculations and references were not fully examined.
sources.findings: Equivalence requires a context-justified indifference region and an appropriate test/interval rule; failure to reject a difference is not a substitute.
sources.limitations: Targeted methodological rationale only; no claim to have reviewed associated bibliographies or implemented/validated a general inference engine.
